BiblicalUsage: Jibnejah is Ibneiah, an Israelite, a son of Jeroham of Benjamin. In 1 Chronicles 9:8, Ibneiah the son of Jeroham.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ibneiah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
